visualReview.notes: All12 current portable frames actually inspected, with all48 final current frames and full main-gateway, front-quarter/casemate/kiosk/placement details. Eleven actual local originals and all62 candidate thumbnails reviewed. Native D-shaped brownstone shell surrounds genuinely open parade court; roof boundary is distinct from2.4384m approximate main-body masonry inset. Four-pilaster rusticated main portal has real rectangular through-door and filled semicircle above, stepped cornice, blank simplified tablet/plaques and two capped chimneys. Opposite rear passage follows native tunnel footway. Covered gray-shingle curved brick-pier walk and straight pale-wood porch/restored quarters, true ports, interior projecting masonry and light plank deck, and two polygonal dark timber kiosks retained. Roof/court cameras broadened to show kiosks fully. Rebuilt the gray roof as matched boundary sections to remove incorrect long diagonal folds while retaining native plans. Heights, exact port/bay/buttress positions, masonry pattern and fine molding remain bounded original photographic estimates.

fidelityReview.scope: Present D-shaped brownstone fort outer footprint and open-court roof opening, two interior kiosks; original8ft wall thickness is distinct from the mapped broad portico/casemate roof ring.
fidelityReview.notes: Exact NPS staff public-domain entrance and restored-courtyard originals confirm the warm brownstone D-shaped open fort, rusticated four-pilaster portal and rectangular through-passage with semicircular masonry above, low chimney caps, covered curved casemates, brick piers and straight pale-columned porch. The official aerial behind the Qualla hero is retained only as historical outer-ring evidence: its unrestored courtyard predates the current canopy and kiosk arrangement, despite the gallery digitization-era date. Current whole, gateway, court, casemate and roof renders match these identifying forms at medium-fi scope. Kiosk roof profiles, exact gunport count/spacing, inner buttresses, fine masonry and hidden junctions remain mapped/architectural estimates. Site signage, historic excavation remains, park scenery and interiors are outside scope. Accepted at the agreed approximate medium-fi exterior scope. No reference pixels are embedded. Previously used attribution/private imagery is excluded from this current review.

Court sky tests exclude current separate kiosks and their small roof overhangs; they still cover the original central open-court requirement.
